candidates.text: Extraordinary conditions may call for extraordinary remedies. But the argument necessarily stops short

candidates.text: Congress cannot delegate legislative power to the President to exercise an unfettered discretion

candidates.text: The Congress is not permitted to abdicate or to transfer to others the essential legislative functions
candidates.speaker: Hughes

candidates.text: Section 3 of the Recovery Act is without precedent. It supplies no standards for any trade
